What this supports

The reviewed letters record appreciation and a recommendation for consideration of collaboration. The letter register identifies authors, dates and references.

Scope & limits

Appreciation is distinct from a licence, procurement contract, signed MoU or clinical endorsement. A recommendation for consideration does not mean the proposed agreement was executed.

Two Telangana letters are undated on their face. The Andhra Pradesh Health letter’s original reference is 270/MINISTER(H,FW&ME)/2025; the handout truncates it.
